title: Systemd: empty CapabilityBoundingSet → crash risk
detail: Empty CapabilityBoundingSet causes status=218/CAPABILITIES → service crash loop. Remove or set explicit capabilities.

title: Systemd: EnvironmentFile without quotes → word splitting
detail: EnvironmentFile= path without quotes is subject to word splitting if path contains spaces.

title: Systemd: User=root or absent → runs as root
detail: Service runs as root — should use unprivileged user. If User= is absent, service also runs as root by default.

title: Systemd: ExecStart with shell metacharacters
detail: ExecStart= command contains shell metacharacters. Commands run via sh -c by default — injection risk.
fix: Use ExecStart= without shell metacharacters, or set explicit arguments.

title: Systemd: StandardOutput= without journald
detail: StandardOutput= not set to journal — logs bypass systemd-journald. Prefer 'StandardOutput=journal'.

title: Systemd: Restart=always without RestartSec
detail: Restart=always without RestartSec — rapid restart loop on failure. Set RestartSec=5 or higher.

title: Systemd: Type=forking without PIDFile
detail: Type=forking requires PIDFile= for proper monitoring. Without it, systemd can't track the main process.

title: Systemd: AmbientCapabilities with ALL caps
detail: AmbientCapabilities=CAP_ALL grants all capabilities — equivalent to root. Use minimal capability set.
